notes.title: A Dream For Aaron v3.0.0 is out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30767441/c47630612a29792f5fc57c9a8760775b1b190442.png[/img]
A Dream For Aaron v3.0.0 is out!
It's a FREE update!

New level: Lava Level 2
New boss: Lava Demon (for Lava Level 2)
Movement reworked
Steam achievements fixed
Added in-game resolution options

More to come!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/709140/A_Dream_For_Aaron/

notes.title: A Dream For Aaron v2.2.0 update!
notes.content:
Version 2.2.0
-New player animations!
-Added a secondary gun - Pistol (along with its own skins)
-Tutorial level
-New enemy - Griff
-Mouse control updated, no more delay
-Now most of the enemies can be killed in one headshot

https://store.steampowered.com/app/709140/A_Dream_For_Aaron/

notes.title: A Dream For Aaron v1.2.0 is out! Halloween update! (Yes, I know it's late)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30767441/a2556063e8dc417c389c172f153e1ff173dd6697.png[/img]
A Dream For Aaron got a halloween update!

Version 1.2.0

Halloween 2017 update

New content:
-New halloween themed map

Three new enemies:
-Pumpkinator
-Pumpkin Grenadier
-Pumpkin and Bombkin

-New Boss: Mr. Cigar

-New gun skin as a reward for completing the halloween event.

The new halloween map gets added to the main game once you complete the event!

I know it's late for the halloween but some things got in a way. It is finally finished, so please enjoy and let me know what you think!
